pool_default_target.description: Default URL endpoint for DNS provider (e.g., BIND, PowerDNS) that receives zone updates.

workers.description: Number of worker threads for the pool manager process to handle DNS updates and health checks.

healthcheck_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks to verify provider availability.

healthcheck_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each health check request before considering a provider unhealthy.

healthcheck_max_retries.description: Number of consecutive health check failures before marking a provider as unhealthy.

retry_interval.description: Initial delay (in seconds) between retries of a failed DNS update.

retry_max_interval.description: Maximum interval (in seconds) between retries for a failed update. Backoff increases up to this value.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the pool manager daemon.

rpc_backend.description: Message broker backend used for RPC communication (e.g., 'rabbit' for RabbitMQ).

rpc_response_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for RPC responses from other OpenStack services.

amqp_url.description: Connection URL for the AMQP broker (e.g., 'amqp://guest:guest@localhost:5672/'). If empty, defaults are used.

ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate file for TLS verification of provider connections (optional).

cert_file.description: Path to client certificate file for mutual TLS (optional).

key_file.description: Path to client private key file for mutual TLS (optional).

rate_limit.description: Maximum DNS update requests per second (0 = no rate limiting).

providers.description: List of DNS provider endpoints associated with this pool.

name.description: Unique name for the provider (used as key in config).

urls.description: List of URLs for this provider (support multiple for HA).
